page.overview:
What is Raw Rabbit?

Raw rabbit is a food item that can be eaten by the player, or cooked in a furnace or a campfire to make cooked rabbit.

To eat raw rabbit, press and hold while it is selected in the hotbar. Eating one restores hunger and 1.8 saturation.

Raw rabbit can be used to breed and heal tamed wolves by 6 Half-Hearts, lead them around, and make baby tamed wolves grow up faster by 10% of the remaining time.

Novice-level Butcher villagers have a chance to buy 4 raw rabbit for an emerald as their trades.
